summary: Standardize reliable autonomous execution from operational evidence

delivery.outcome: Autonomy 0.2 requires durable and independently watched execution, per-repository outcome isolation, protected registry consistency and fresh live canary evidence while retaining no-per-PR-human publication.
nonGoals: Implement a scheduler, queue, watchdog or Validator runtime in Wellmanifest
Treat manual workflow dispatch as scheduler liveness evidence
Permit unrelated repository failures to weaken a target's own gates
Enable platform-native auto-merge or direct default-branch push

architecture.decision: Standardize a durable execution plane with protected primary trigger, independent watchdog, exact idempotency, per-repository isolation, one protected onboarding registry and freshness-bound canary receipts.
interfaceChanges: Require the executionLiveness policy and explicit protected merge semantics
dataChanges: Add durable queue, trigger, watchdog, registry, isolation and canary bindings
Add trigger-delivery, queue-claim, registry-resolution, canary and branch-cleanup receipts
architecture.rollback: Revert the v2 contract commit through the same protected publication boundary; retain v0.1 audit evidence.
